prompt: ok so I want to build a notification system. users should get emails when something happens in the app

assertions.description: Asks the engineer to explain the problem in their own words before any design discussion
Asks which specific events trigger a notification — does not assume a single event type
Asks what happens if the email service is down or delivery fails
Asks whether users can opt out or configure their notification preferences
Ends response with exactly one focused question at the bottom, not a list
